query:
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg((to_jsonb(p) - 'author_id' - 'scope_key')
                      || jsonb_build_object('work_title', w.title, 'club_name', c.name)
                  ORDER BY p.id), '[]') AS "rows!"
           FROM posts p
           JOIN works w ON w.id = p.work_id
           LEFT JOIN clubs c ON c.id = p.club_id
           WHERE p.author_id = $1
